name: Aurora Store
description: A modern e-commerce storefront prototype, frontend only, built with React. It has at most five pages: a landing page with featured products, a search and listing page, a product detail page, a checkout page, and one extra page (order confirmation). Products are mock data kept in the repository; there is no backend, no payment processing and no user accounts. The look is a current, polished e-commerce design: strong product imagery areas, clean typography, responsive from phone to desktop, accessible, with sensible loading, empty and error states.

options.out_of_scope:
Real payment processing
User accounts and login
A backend or database
More than five pages
options.constraints:
Frontend only; all data is mock data kept in the repository
Exactly these pages: landing, search, product detail, checkout, order confirmation
Keep dependencies few and well known
